entities.summary: Zhang Ji was a military general who played a pivotal role in the late Eastern Han dynasty of China. He served under the warlord Dong Zhuo, a key figure in the warlord era of ancient China. Zhang Ji's military campaigns were marked by brutal suppression and violence, leaving a lasting legacy of bloodshed and instability in the region. His actions had significant consequences for the future of China, contributing to the eventual collapse of the Han dynasty and paving the way for the rise of new powers. The impact of Zhang Ji's reign can still be felt today, with many historians regarding him as one of the most notorious warlords in Chinese history. He died in 196 CE, a victim of the very violence and instability he had helped to create.
